answer: Post a refundable bond of 50 POA per identity, then spot-audit a random 5% each epoch: summoned agents must pass a 10-minute interactive check. Step 1: post the bond, refunded after 30 clean epochs. Step 2: answer the summons or take a strike. Step 3: three strikes burn the bond. Honest agents pass trivially. An attacker with 1,000 hollow identities must lock 50,000 POA and staff each summons, about 50 live responses costing 8 operator-hours per cycle. Like a mesa over the desert, one solid identity rises above the fog while the nebula of fakes dissolves, revealing how hollow they were.
